name: Artifacts
description: Lists the claude.ai Artifacts and Orca chat visuals Claude made in this repo's worktrees, in the right sidebar, and opens them in Orca's browser with one click.

cover.alt: Three dark Orca sidebar panels from the Artifacts plugin, side by side under the headline 'Artifacts for Orca': a List view grouped by date, a Cards view with preview thumbnails, and a Sessions view showing the artifacts each Claude session made.

screenshots.alt: The Artifacts panel in its three views: List grouped by date, Cards with previews and a pinned rail, and Sessions with a timeline per Claude chat.
screenshots.caption: List, Cards and Sessions views

commands.title: Artifacts: Show or hide the right sidebar

settings.title: Orca CLI path (optional)
settings.description: Full path to orca.exe / orca if it is not found automatically.

settings.title: Claude config folders (optional)
settings.description: One folder per line that holds a projects directory (e.g. ~/.claude). Empty = auto-detect.

settings.title: Preview thumbnails
settings.description: Capture card previews locally: claude.ai artifacts from Orca's browser when you open them, chat visuals with a headless Edge/Chrome restricted to Orca's CDN allowlist. Turn off to disable all capturing.

settings.title: Browser path for visual previews (optional)
settings.description: Full path to msedge.exe / chrome.exe if it is not found automatically.
